item.title: John & Paul, and Wings
item.description:
I read John & Paul, a Love Story in Songs by Ina Leslie. Great read, but through this discovered Wings - and have been enjoying their music too! (I had heard some of Lennon’s solo albums, but hadn’t heard much of the Wings)

John & Paul Link to heading

The Wings Link to heading

item.title: Brit Music
item.description:
A few months ago - when my daughter joined college in London - she asked me for a playlist with British music. I knew that much of the music I enjoyed was from the UK, but I didn’t realize how much of it was (Dusty Springfield is Brit?! Cliff Richard is Brit?!)! I ended up making 3 playlists:

Brit Classic Rock

Brit 4P’s - For Punk, Prog Rock, Prog, and Pop!
